query:
INSERT INTO characters (
            user_id, first_name, last_name, class, race, sex, level, reached_60_at, ruleset
        )
        VALUES (
            $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, COALESCE($7::smallint, 1),
            CASE WHEN $7::smallint = 60 THEN COALESCE($8, now()) END,
            $9::text
        )
        RETURNING id
